news.title: Hornets to retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey
news.text: The Hornets will retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey on Feb. 11. Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history, is the franchise leader in assists, steals and minutes.

news.title: Brandon Miller scores career-high 39 points as Hornets beat Wizards 110-103
news.text: — Brandon Miller scored a career-high 39 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Washington Wizards 110-103 on Monday night for their third win in four games to open the season.

news.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo fouls out vs. Hornets as Heat tumble to 0-3
news.text: The Heat fell to 0-3 after a 115-110 loss to the undermanned Hornets in which Giannis Antetokounmpo scored just 14 points before fouling out.

news.title: Brandon Miller scores 34 points as the Hornets beat the winless Heat 115-110
news.text: — Brandon Miller scored 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the winless Miami Heat 115-110 on Saturday, bouncing back from one of the worst losses in franchise history a night earlier.

news.title: Hornets blown out by Hawks 128-81 in first game home without LaMelo Ball, booed by sellout crowd
news.text: — Jalen Johnson had 19 points, eight assists and seven rebounds and Atlanta hammered the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday night in the Hawks' largest blowout in franchise history.

news.title: Naz Reid has 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut as the Hornets beat the Nets 110-103
news.text: — Naz Reid had 20 points and 11 rebounds in his Charlotte debut, Grayson Allen added 21 points off the bench and the Hornets beat the Brooklyn Nets 110-103 on Wednesday night.

news.text: The Hornets will be without guards Kon Knueppel and Coby White as well as veteran forward Grant Williams as they open their season Wednesday at Brooklyn.
